description: Reload pointers after compaction or resume in Workbench projects. PostCompact covers the Pi bridge, which does not emit SessionStart on compaction.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session-context.py"; else exec python -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session-context.py"; fi
